name: Painting
description: Interior walls by height (new and repaint), wall areas, ceilings, doors and frames, trim, caulk, exterior siding and block, epoxy floors. Spread rates are starting figures to replace with your products’ data sheets. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: MPI Architectural Painting Specification Manual (paint systems by substrate)
The product data sheet of the coating, adhesive or product you specify (spread rate, coverage, coats)
Plain geometry: the quantity follows from the measured length, height or area and the stated module (no outside source needed)

assume: Primer: 300 SF per gallon, one coat (a starting figure: use the primer's data sheet).
Finish: 350 SF per gallon per coat, two coats (a starting figure: use the paint's data sheet).
No deduction for openings under 100 SF; sundries (tape, masking, caulk) are not counted.
items.note: Measure the wall run (one side); the item height is the painted height (A = run x height).
items.name: Paint walls, new gypsum board, primer + two finish coats, 8 ft
